You control at least one additional artifact

3532-3836-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

333-6797-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-6797-7424.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7161.easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Mouser such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
6972-7161.description:
Kill Arcbound Mouser.
When Arcbound Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Mouser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Mouser dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.
6972-7161.notes: This combo will end the game in a draw if it isn't interacted with, as it creates a mandatory infinite loop.

When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1497-2842-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

454-1978-5614.description:
Cause Bighorner Rancher to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat from step 2.

When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

643-3951-4050-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-4050-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-4050-5263.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding one mana of any color.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.

When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.

When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1495-4120-5902.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-4120-5902.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-4120-5902.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

1520-1806-2034-4452.description:

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.

Thornbite Staff attached to Royal Assassin.

Holding priority, activate Royal Assassin by tapping it, destroying the creature.
When the creature dies, Royal Assassin triggers, untapping Royal Assassin.
Repeat.

Each Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve an Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Goblin Bombardment any number of times by sacrificing any number of creature tokens, dealing that much damage to any target(s).

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
